reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message: "Thanks, Ilse. Noted: the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date is 25 November. I'm not taking any action on it."

I checked the public North cheat sheet first. It lists Brackenwater but gives no renewal date, so nothing on file contradicts hers. I didn't save the date to any file. A renewal date counts as an account detail, not a money figure, so posting it in the team channel didn't need anyone's approval.
